scope: Current applicability questions; accepted current-source economics and engineering evidence are retained separately.
scan_rule: Follow research/registry.json families[].research_questions and select status=pending_validation. Read current_evidence separately; a pending hypothesis does not invalidate an accepted bounded result.

current_evidence.boundary: Current accepted comparisons retain their own source/account bindings. Attribution and clock diagnostics do not by themselves establish a profitable intervention or native/live equivalence.

questions.question: Can a loss attribution be converted into a validated causal intervention?
questions.question_zh: 损失归因能否转化成经过验证的因果干预？
gaps: A repair failure, adverse markout or portfolio concentration can describe losses without proving a usable predictor or intervention.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Distinguish descriptive fill/lot/episode decomposition from action counterfactuals; reconstruct visible state, baseline and denominator before a paired or randomized test.
